edits.find:
About this Calculator

A Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) lets you invest a fixed amount every month. Compounding means your returns also start earning returns, so the growth curve accelerates over time.

Formula

Maturity Value = P × [(1+r)n − 1] ÷ r × (1+r) — where P is the monthly investment, r is the monthly return rate, and n is the number of months.
